The story follows Fumihito, a once-popular erotic manga artist who is now facing a decline in his career and losing his fan base. One day, an inexperienced editor named Marika is assigned to him, despite knowing nothing about erotic manga. Marika desperately asks Fumihito for a manuscript, hoping to revive his creativity. However, Fumihito, feeling insulted by the assignment and uninterested in Marika, initially tries to push her away. Marika, determined to succeed, offers to do anything to help. Fumihito challenges her to pose as a model for erotic manga, expecting her to refuse. Surprisingly, Marika, who has no experience in such matters, reluctantly agrees and poses in increasingly embarrassing and revealing positions. As Fumihito witnesses her vulnerability, his creative inspiration is reignited, and he passionately resumes his work. The resulting artwork receives acclaim from both the editor and readers, leading to Fumihito securing a regular serialization once again. Thus, Marika, the rookie editor, becomes a frequent visitor to Fumihito’s room to collect his monthly serial manuscripts.
